language.note: The only country with English as its sole official language on mainland South America

terrainDescription.zh: 絕大部分國土為茂密雨林，人口集中於狹窄的沿海農業平原，南部則有魯普魯尼稀樹草原。
terrainDescription.en: The vast majority of the country is dense rainforest, with population concentrated on a narrow coastal agricultural strip and savanna (the Rupununi) in the south.

historicalContext.zh: 蓋亞那是南美洲大陸唯一以英語為官方語言的國家，也與蘇利南並列全南美僅有的兩個靠左行駛國家——皆為英國/荷蘭殖民歷史遺留，與周邊西語系、靠右行駛鄰國形成強烈對比。
historicalContext.en: Guyana is the only country on mainland South America with English as its sole official language, and — alongside Suriname — one of only two South American countries that drive on the left, a legacy of British/Dutch colonial rule that stands in sharp contrast to its Spanish-speaking, right-hand-drive neighbors.
